# Upstream desktop workflows (reference only)

These workflow files are preserved from the upstream `EthanYoQ/AI-Novel-Writer` baseline. They are outside `.github/workflows/`, so GitHub Actions does not execute them in this native-Web derivative.

The active build pipeline is `../workflows/native-web-image.yml`. It builds the native browser/Node image rather than Windows/macOS installers. Keeping the upstream definitions here preserves provenance without silently triggering unrelated desktop release jobs or inheriting their publication assumptions.

Source and license: see the repository's `LICENSE`, retained from upstream (GPL-3.0).
